result.instructions: Tools for Nookal, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nookal data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run nookal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nookal_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nookal_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. nookal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nookal_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the clinic's locations (id, name, address, time zone, active). Location ids are needed by most other tools. Only the locations your API client was granted are returned. Nookal GraphQL: locations.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

active.description: true = only active locations, false = only inactive.

tools.name: nookal_list_staff
tools.title: List practitioners and staff
tools.description: List staff members and practitioners (id, name, title, speciality, email, location ids, whether they are a provider / bookable online / active). Use the staff ids as provider_ids in list_appointments and staff_ids in get_availability. Nookal GraphQL: staff.

location_ids.description: Only these locations' staff (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

staff_ids.description: Only these staff members (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

active.description: true = only active staff, false = only inactive (Nookal status 1/0).

providers_only.description: true = only clinical providers (practitioners), false = only non-providers.

online_bookings.description: true = only staff bookable online, false = only staff not bookable online.

tools.name: nookal_list_services
tools.title: List services (appointment types)
tools.description: List the appointment types / services offered (id, name, category, duration in minutes, price, location, online-booking settings). Use a service id in get_availability. Nookal GraphQL: services.

location_ids.description: Only these locations' services (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

service_ids.description: Only these services (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

online_bookings.description: true = only services bookable online, false = only diary-only services.

tools.name: nookal_list_classes
tools.title: List class types
tools.description: List the class types offered (id, name, category, duration, price, location, online-booking settings) — the class definitions, not individual sessions. Nookal GraphQL: classes.

location_ids.description: Only these locations' classes (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

class_ids.description: Only these class types (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

online_bookings.description: true = only classes bookable online, false = only diary-only classes.

tools.name: nookal_get_availability
tools.title: Get appointment availability
tools.description: Get the free appointment slots per date between two dates (max 60 days, Nookal's limit), optionally for given locations, practitioners and a service. Each slot has its date, start time (24h, clinic local time), provider id and location id. Read-only: it does not book anything. Nookal GraphQL: availabilities.

date_to.description: Last date, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 60 days after date_from).

location_ids.description: Only these locations (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

staff_ids.description: Only these practitioners (staff ids) (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

service_id.description: Only slots for this service / appointment type id (from list_services).

slot_duration.description: Override the slot length in minutes.

tools.name: nookal_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments (date, start/end time, status, type, client, practitioner, case, location, arrived / did-not-arrive flags, notes), filtered by date range, location, client, practitioner, type and status. Dates are clinic local. Nookal GraphQL: appointments.

date_from.description: Appointments on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Appointments on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

client_ids.description: Only these clients (patients) (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

provider_ids.description: Only these practitioners (staff ids) (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

appointment_ids.description: Only these appointments (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

appt_statuses.description: Statuses as Nookal names them, e.g. ["Completed"], ["Cancelled"], ["DNA"] (did not arrive), ["Pending"].

modified_from.description: Only appointments created/updated after this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

modified_to.description: Only appointments created/updated before this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

tools.name: nookal_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients (patients)
tools.description: Find clients (patients) by name, date of birth, mobile, email or id. Returns id, name, date of birth, location, active/deceased flags and contact details. With partial_match, names match on their first letters (e.g. 'Sm' finds Smith). Nookal GraphQL: clients.

first_name.description: First name (exact, or its first letters with partial_match).

last_name.description: Last name (exact, or its first letters with partial_match).

partial_match.description: true = match names that start with the given letters.

mobile.description: Mobile number, digits only with no spaces.

client_ids.description: Only these clients (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

location_ids.description: Only these locations' clients (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

active.description: true = only active clients, false = only inactive.

deceased.description: true = only deceased clients, false = only living clients.

modified_from.description: Only clients created/updated after this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

tools.name: nookal_get_client
tools.title: Get a client (patient)
tools.description: Get one client (patient) by id: name, date of birth, contact details, addresses, alerts, allergies, notes, occupation, referring doctor and their treatment cases; optionally a summary of their invoices (totals and balances). Health-fund, pension and online-booking codes are not returned. Nookal GraphQL: clients.

include_invoices.description: true = also list the client's invoices (number, date, total, paid, balance).

tools.name: nookal_list_cases
tools.title: List treatment cases
tools.description: List treatment cases (id, client, title, start and referral dates, referrer, primary practitioner, notes), filtered by client, case or practitioner. Nookal GraphQL: cases.

client_ids.description: Only these clients' cases (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

case_ids.description: Only these cases (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

primary_provider_ids.description: Only these primary practitioners' cases (staff ids) (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

tools.name: nookal_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their line items and payments (number, client, case, location, practitioner, date, subtotal, tax, total, paid, balance), filtered by location, invoice id or creation date. For one client's invoices use get_client with include_invoices. Nookal GraphQL: invoices.

location_ids.description: Only these locations' invoices (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

invoice_ids.description: Only these invoices (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

created_from.description: Invoices created on/after this (YYYY-MM-DD = from 00:00:00, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; clinic local time).

created_to.description: Invoices created on/before this (YYYY-MM-DD = until 23:59:59, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; clinic local time).

tools.name: nookal_list_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: List payments received against invoices (method, amount, date, reference, invoice, client, location), filtered by invoice or payment date. Nookal GraphQL: payments.

invoice_ids.description: Only these invoices' payments (numeric Nookal ids, up to 100).

date_from.description: Payments on/after this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, clinic local time).

date_to.description: Payments on/before this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, clinic local time).
